origin.description: Predict a response by the mean of the neighbor responses.
origin.details: When test is omitted, the prediction is leave-one-out and the result includes residuals, PRESS, and R2Pred.
origin.example: leave-one-out knn.reg on the six-point train with y = c(1, 1, 1, 4, 4, 4), k=2

translation.description: With test omitted, knn_reg predicts the mean of the neighbor responses and reports PRESS and R2Pred.
